summary: Iteration 19 — RETEST of 4 fixes: (1) DELETE /api/bhakti/items/:id 404 bug for content_items, (2) PUT /api/bhakti/items/:id resolver gap, (3) PATCH /api/bhakti/items/:id/status resolver gap, (4) new Full Text tab + multilingual sub-tabs + Aarti hides Verses tab. ALL GREEN. Backend: 24/24 pytest pass (4 new iter19 resolver cases + 8 iter18 + 12 iter16) in 16.7s. The iter19 cases create a throwaway content_items doc via POST /api/content/items, then exercise /api/bhakti/items/:id PUT (200, title_hi persisted in content_items), PATCH /status (200, status='archived' persisted), DELETE (200 success — was 404 before fix), plus a 404 sanity check on a non-existent id. Frontend: Aarti drawer (/admin/arti-manager?edit=69f1e1a77488457efddb02b7) shows exactly the 5 expected tabs [content, fulltext, audio, sync, publish] — Verses tab correctly hidden. Full Text tab Hindi sub-tab → typed unique TEST_iter19_FT_1777551585 → click fulltext-save-btn → PUT /api/content/items/69f1e1a77488457efddb02b7 returned 200; readback confirms BOTH languages.hi.full_text AND legacy text_hi mirror are populated. 'Full text saved' success toast visible. Chalisa drawer (/admin/chalisa-manager?edit=69f053c8053b601fc045a5ca) has both drawer-tab-fulltext and drawer-tab-verses. 'Save new verse' regression: clicked Add Verse → typed sanskrit → save-new-verse-btn → POST /api/content/items/.../verses returned 200 in <3s; new verse 'TEST_iter19_verse_1777551528' appears at top of list with 'Verse added' toast. NOT stuck. AUDIO_SYNC_GUIDE.md exists with 341 lines.

BhaktiEditorDrawer.js:300-321 (FullTextTab.save) — writes both per-language languages.{code}.full_text AND legacy text_{code} mirror in one PUT /content/items/:id call. Single round-trip. Good.

Save-new-verse path (POST /content/items/:id/verses) is not new code but iter18's resolver work made it work transparently for bhakti_items / content_items items — iter19 confirms the user-reported hang is gone (response in <1s, 200 OK, success toast renders).

rca of the issue: Original iter18.5 user feedback: DELETE Hanuman Chalisa returned 404 because /api/bhakti/items/:id only looked in bhakti_items collection while Chalisa lives in content_items. Same gap caused 'save new verse stuck' (silent no-op writes) on /bhakti/items endpoints. Main agent's fix: extended _resolve_item_collections from iter18 to also drive PUT, PATCH /status, DELETE on /bhakti/items/:id (server.py 1058-1129). iter19 retest confirms: throwaway content_items item created via /api/content/items can be PUT/PATCHED/DELETED via /api/bhakti/items/:id with 200s and persistence in content_items. Frontend Full Text tab and Aarti tab list also verified.
